url: https://www.paloaltoonline.com/food/roundup-food/2026/08/11/the-veggie-edit-10-vegan-and-vegetarian-eateries-on-the-peninsula/

Spicy yellow curry at Wildseed in Palo Alto’s Town & Country Village. Courtesy Wildseed. When dining out on the Peninsula these days, it’s usually not difficult to find some plant-based options, but for those who follow vegetarians and vegan diets, it’s especially gratifying to support businesses that are specifically meatless or entirely animal-product free.
There’s nothing like the feeling of browsing a menu with the knowledge that all of it is available to you (and, of course, you don’t have to be vegan to enjoy a delicious, plant-based meal). Here are 10 vegetarian restaurants (many of which are fully vegan) on the Peninsula – from beloved classics to fresh establishments that have opened more recently.
Chaat Bhavan, Mountain View and Sunnyvale (vegetarian)
When Gary Singh moved to the Bay Area a couple of decades ago, he found himself missing the taste of homemade Indian food and opened the first Chaat Bhavan Vegetarian Restaurant in Fremont in 2009.
Chaat Bhavan has since expanded into a small local chain, with outposts in Mountain View and Sunnyvale. The restaurant has a huge menu with plenty of choices from across India, such as dumpling curries, snacks, thali and Indo-Chinese items, plus specialty drinks and desserts. Vegan dishes are noted on the menu.
Chaat Bhavan, 165 E. El Camino Real, Mountain View, 976 E. El Camino Real, Sunnyvale and 544 Lawrence Expressway, Sunnyvale (Chaat Bhavan Express); Instagram: @chaatbhavan.official. Check online for location hours.
Falafelle, Belmont (vegetarian)
Falafelle in Belmont specializes in falafel. Courtesy Falafelle. This unassuming Mediterranean (and mostly vegan) vegetarian street-food spot in Belmont specializes in crunchy and flavorful falafel made from scratch. It’s offered in various formats and combos, including wraps and pita sandwiches. You can also find salads, pickles, labneh and fries, among other items.
Falafelle, 1035 Ralston Ave., Belmont; Instagram: @falafelle.us. Open Monday to Friday from 11 a.m. to 8:30 p.m. and Saturday from 11 a.m. to 8 p.m.
Garden Fresh, Mountain View (vegan)
Garden Fresh offers vegan Chinese food, including vegan orange chicken with broccoli. Courtesy Garden Fresh. Though the downtown Palo Alto branch of Garden Fresh is no more, the longtime Mountain View location – winner of the Best Vegetarian Cuisine category in this news organization’s 2024’s Best of Mountain View contest – is still going strong.
For many years, Garden Fresh has been cooking up vegan versions of Chinese classics such as crispy sesame “chicken,” vegetarian “beef” with broccoli, sweet-and-sour “pork” and so much more.
Garden Fresh, 1245 W. El Camino Real, Mountain View. Open Tuesday to Sunday from 11:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. and 4:30-9:30 p.m.
Happy Flower Eatery & Boba, Sunnyvale (vegan)
Happy Flower Eatery & Boba, which opened in 2023, is indeed a very happy place for Vietnamese food fans, offering fresh vegan soups, rolls, banh mi, lemongrass entrees, noodles and lunch plates, plus boba drinks and some Thai, Malaysian and other specialities.
Happy Flower Eatery & Boba, 1274 Persian Drive, Sunnyvale; Instagram: @happyflowereatery. Open Wednesday to Monday from 11 a.m. to 9 p.m. (closed for vacation through Aug. 19).
Merit Vegan Restaurant, Sunnyvale (vegan)
This longtime favorite offers a big menu of plant-based dishes, many of which draw from Vietnamese and Southeast Asian cuisine, such as the Viet sweet-sour soup, Saigon noodle soup and vegan pho, plus a selection of desserts such as tiramisu, Oreo cheesecake and peanut butter pie. Merit’s website also features a free video library and a blog with articles on veganism.
Merit Vegan Restaurant, 548 Lawrence Expressway, Suite 2, Sunnyvale; Instagram: @meritvegetarian. Open daily from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. and 4:30-8 p.m.

turns.text:
Choose the heat pump. In Palo Alto's mild climate one unit does both heating and cooling. City of Palo Alto Utilities (CPAU) pays $2,500 when it replaces a gas heater, or $5,000 if you're income-eligible.

- **Upfront cost:** about $10K–$18K for a heat pump, against $7K–$12K for a furnace plus AC.
- **Incentives:** the federal 25C credit has ended. TECH Clean California and BayREN Home+ are closed or waitlisted, so check them before you count on them.
- **Unconfirmed:** 10 of the 39 claims couldn't be verified, and one unsupported claim was removed. Lake Tahoe–Nevada State Park — State park on Lake Tahoe in Nevada, United States
   Lake Tahoe–Nevada State Park is a state park comprising multiple management units and public recreation areas on the northeast shores of Lake Tahoe in the U.S. state of Nevada. The park covers approximately 14,301 acres (5,787 ha).

rows: Leave Palo Alto by ~1pm (about 4.5 hr, check I-80/US-50 chains). Check in, dinner and stroll at Heavenly Village.
Emerald Bay overlook, Vikingsholm, Eagle Falls. Lunch in Tahoe City. Afternoon at Sand Harbor (warmest day, ~50°F). Dinner back in South Lake.
Breakfast, Heavenly gondola or Tallac Historic Site/Pope Beach walk. Leave by noon to beat traffic.

blocks.text: Nights near 26–31°F: carry chains and check Caltrans road conditions before leaving.

Driving from Palo Alto, so no flights needed.

Your trip is set for Fri–Sun, Nov 6–8, driving from Palo Alto. The forecast is overcast and cold, with lows of 26–31°F and no meaningful rain. Saturday is the warmest day, so it's the best one for the lake sights.

For a stay, I'd look at the Airbnb condo "Mauna Lua" ($172/night, 4.98 rating) or the Hilton Vacation Club Tahoe Seasons (about $100/night). The stays card has the links, and booking is yours to finish. Distances and drive times in the plan are my estimates, not tool results.
